claims.claim: The Canon EOS 5D Mark II is a full-frame DSLR camera known for its 21.1-megapixel sensor.
claims.evidence: Photo 0 front right and Photo 2 bottom label show Canon EOS 5D Mark II.
Photo 0 shows Canon on top; Photo 2 shows Canon DS126021 label.

response.reason: The witness identifies a Canon EOS 5D Mark II, so the item can be priced at its worst case; the seller's claim that it is a Sony is contradicted by the photos.
